title: fix(app-shell): zh-CN Studio reads in Chinese in the view, page and report panels, the publish sheet, the flow Problems note and the save-notice / notify nodes; dashboard is 仪表盘
body:
Refs #30039 (every position and Acceptance 1-4 are done here; Acceptance 5, the browser screenshots, is not: see Verification. The server-side zh-CN metadata-forms bundle still says 仪表板 for the dashboard form, in `packages/platform-objects`, which this PR does not touch.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:中文控制台下,Studio 的视图/页面/报表属性面板、发布清单的属性名与类型计数、流程「问题」页的未运行说明、保存提示与通知节点的字段,都改为中文;仪表板统一叫「仪表盘」。
- 为什么改:中文管理员在编辑视图、检查发布内容、看流程状态时一直读到英文开发者文字,同一个对象还有两个叫法。
- 风险与回滚:只改界面文字和一条说明的取词,不改任何数据或接口;英文控制台不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-problems.ts`(按 `unboundCause` 选说明)、`metadata-form-i18n.ts`(覆盖表接入)、`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`(新的中文数据表)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中 objectstack#30039 一组断言视图面板为「基础信息 / 列与筛选」、流程 Status 为「状态」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Spec forms the console renders from its own copy of the spec (Position 1, Acceptance 2).** `localizeMetadataForm`'s zh-CN bundle named only `dashboard`. It now names every `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` type (17), from the new data module `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`. The words are the platform's own zh-CN metadata-forms bundle (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, which `/api/v1/meta/types` localizes the same forms with), copied leaf for leaf. Leaves the platform has not translated are left out.

| Type | Depth added | Why that depth |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `view`, `page`, `report` | type label, every section label and description, every field label, help text and placeholder | their curated inspectors render the bundled spec form; `getViewForm`, `getPageForm` and `getReportForm` now take the locale and pass through the overlay, as `getDashboardForm` already did |
| `dashboard` | unchanged hand-worded rows (term fixed to 仪表盘) | already covered |
| `object`, `field`, `hook`, `dataset`, `app`, `position`, `action`, `agent`, `tool`, `skill`, `flow`, `permission`, `email_template` | type label and field labels only | their inspectors render the server's form, already localized; the one console-side reader is the Pending changes sheet, which names a changed property by its form row's label |

Left out: none of the registry types. Types outside `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` (`object_extension`, `job`, `datasource`, and the rest of the platform bundle) have no form the console renders from its own spec copy, and the publish sheet names their properties by key, so the overlay names none of them. The ⛔ composite rule holds: a pin walks every registry form and checks that no composite without declared `fields` gets sub-fields synthesized.

**Publish sheet (Positions 2, 3).** `~ Status` reads `~ 状态` through the overlay above. The summary's type count gains a `dataset` family (`数据集 1`). The console locale packs are held to full key parity by `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`, so the family is added to all ten packs, not only en and zh.

**Flow Problems tab (Position 4, Acceptance 3).** The runtime row's `unboundCause` (the contract's `FLOW_UNBOUND_CAUSES`) now rides into `FlowRuntimeRow`, and `deriveFlowRunStatus` carries it as `cause`. `describeFlowRunStatus` words each known cause with a designer-table row (en and zh) that says what this deployment does not do and who can change it. For `missing_trigger`: 「此部署不运行由这类触发器启动的流程。开发人员可以在应用中加入相应的触发器包，之后该流程就会运行。」. The engine's sentence moves to the line's hover text (`detail`). A cause with no row keeps the engine's sentence. With the note shown and no structural problem, the line below reads 「结构检查没有发现需要修改的地方。该流程不在此运行的原因见上方说明。」 instead of 没有问题 —— 该流程结构有效.

**Flow palette and notify node (Position 5).** No ui-side overlay existed for these descriptors, but the keyed tables for descriptor labels did, and this PR uses them: `engine.flowNode.save_notice.{label,hint}` (palette), and `FLOW_FIELD_ZH` rows for `notify.template`, `notify.templateData` and `save_notice.message` (inspector). The server descriptors stay English.

**Terms (Position 6, Acceptance 4).** Every 仪表板 in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`, the metadata-admin type label table and the overlay is now 仪表盘. Tests that spelled the old word are updated.

## Tests

Run at `c92c71942` (the code head; `fa6bbe2b2` adds only the changeset):

- `metadata-form-i18n.test.ts`, new describe: every registry type has a zh overlay and none at en; the view panel's sections and `searchableFields` read in Chinese and the en form stays English; page and report forms read in Chinese; no composite gets sub-fields synthesized; `formKeyLabel('flow','status','zh-CN') === '状态'`; no zh form row says 仪表板.
- `flow-problems.runStatus-11779.test.ts`, new describe: the cause rides through; a known cause reads its row in zh and en with the engine's sentence as `detail`; every `FLOW_UNBOUND_CAUSES` member has a row in both tables; an unknown cause keeps the engine's sentence (control).
- `flow-node-config.test.ts`, new describe: notify Template / Template data and save_notice Message read in Chinese; the palette names save_notice 保存提示; English stays English (control).
- Updated: `StudioDesignSurface.flowStatusTruth-11779` (the empty line below a not-running note), `metadataError.reportHeld-27785` (the report row label now reads 排序依据), `metadata-form-i18n` and `SchemaForm.machineNameChip-8231` (their uncovered-type example moves from `report` to `job`), and the 仪表板 spellings in three app-shell and three plugin-chatbot tests.

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

- Affected set, 221 files across app-shell, plugin-chatbot and all of `packages/i18n/src`: first run 4 failed / 2697 passed (the four expectations above that this change moves); after the updates, the 22 touched files: `Test Files 22 passed (22)`, `Tests 294 passed (294)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- After merging `origin/main` (917f024d9) at head `e7fe2905c`: 169 files (the touched set, `src/preview` and all of `packages/i18n/src`) gave `Test Files 168 passed`, plus 1 failure in `dashboard-range-preset-labels-4984`. That failure was a stale `packages/spec/dist` (the merge brought new date-range presets). After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` the file passes: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=./ui/packages/app-shell --filter=./ui/packages/i18n`: `Tasks: 69 successful, 69 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed shape. The new pins assert new rows, each paired with an English control.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The 17-type zh table is a copy of the platform's bundle, not a read of it. `@object-ui/app-shell` has no dependency on `@objectstack/platform-objects`, and importing that bundle would add all four locales (about 440 KB of source) to the console's eager graph. The copy is 8.6 KB gzipped. A later change that rewords a platform leaf does not reach it.
- Not reproduced here: whether "Add filter" in the view panel is still English. It comes from `FilterBuilder`'s `filterBuilder.addFilter`, which the zh pack already translates (`添加筛选`). No browser run could confirm it.
- The report form's console-added `Filter` section (added only when the bundled spec lacks `runtimeFilter`) has no slug the bundle names, so it would stay English. It is dormant on today's spec.
- Server half, not touched (⛔ `packages/**`): the platform zh-CN metadata-forms bundle names the dashboard form 仪表板 on six lines (`zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts:1398-1475`), and the `save_notice` / `notify` descriptors stay English at their source.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates at fa6bbe2b2</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (39 paths vs merge base 471add32d): 35 commands, each run, each exit 0. That covers check-adr-0087-registration (plus self-test), check-changeset-no-major, check-closing-keyword-parity (plus self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, check-empty-changeset (plus self-test), check-sdui-manifest (plus self-test), release-rehearsal-clone self-test, release-pending-publish self-test, spec check:duration-unit-keys, check:changeset-gate-self-tests, closed-ceremony-text, cross-package-test-inputs, dispatcher-error-vocabulary, driver-memory-census, engine-double-contract, gitlink-declared, nul-bytes, published-files, query-options-erasure, refd-timer-probe, registry-log-declared, rest-log-spy-declared, skill-identifier-liveness, test-source-alias, tier-file-adoption, type-check-coverage, type-check-debt, undeclared-dep-imports, watch-hint-literal and where-matcher. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` ran after the seven @objectstack builds: `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 4985 passed | 2 skipped`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

NOT MEASURED: browser screenshots (Acceptance 5). The positions need a running backend: the Studio Interfaces view inspector, the Pending changes sheet over real drafts, and a flow row from `GET /api/v1/automation/_status`. The console's offline preview gallery renders none of them (no default inspector without a selection, no runtime row, no publish sheet). Booting showcase or CRM plus the console was not done in this container. The eager-closure budget is a console-build gate, and CI runs it.
